facts.fact: Minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabane said 183 of 1,700 identified white zones without mobile or internet service were connected in 2022 through the universal access fund FASU, which invested FCFA 6.2bn.
On 27 August 2024 the minister announced that the government will itself invest to cover 1,000 more white zones without mobile and internet service over the next three years.

systems.system: FASU (Fonds pour l'acces et le service universels)
